2.88.54
Chart.Top
The Chart.Top element specifies the distance of a Chart from the top of the chart's container, such as
a Rectangle or Body. This element is optional. If the Chart.Top element is present, its value MUST be
a non-negative RdlSize. If the Chart.Top element is not present, its value is interpreted as 0.
Following is the parent element of the Chart.Top element.
Parent elements
Chart
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Chart.Top element.
 <xsd:element name="Top" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
